history.summary: A freehold 1,205 sqft 2BR (built 2010) at $1.999M / $1,659 PSF in D05, 790m from Haw Par Villa MRT (Circle Line). The very generous 1,205 sqft for a 2BR depresses headline PSF, but the $2.0M quantum is high for a 2BR, and the 7.56% appreciation rests on just 3 URA transactions — statistically meaningless.
history.rating_rationale: The eye-catching 7.56% CAGR is built on only 3 txns — unusable. The 1,205 sqft 2BR is oversized: it makes PSF ($1,659) look modest but pushes quantum to $2.0M for a unit that rents like a 2BR, capping yield. PSF is ~5.7% above the (also-thin) $1,569 median. Offsetting: freehold, One-North/West Coast (D05) growth corridor, and Circle Line access 790m away. Mixed — decent location and tenure, but thin data and quantum/size mismatch.
red_flags: 7.56% appreciation on only 3 URA txns — statistically meaningless
Oversized 1,205 sqft 2BR pushes quantum to $2.0M with no rental upside (yield drag)
PSF ~5.7% above the (thin) URA median; record shows many draws (uncertain Elo)
catalysts: Freehold in D05 near One-North / West Coast tech-employment growth corridor

Generous layout appeals to space-seeking owner-occupier resale buyers

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Cannot rely on 7.56% (3 txns). D05's One-North corridor supports above-OCR appreciation, but I treat the rate as district-typical RCR until more trades confirm.
